The tree under acceptance was shipped over the production image's editable install inside a throwaway container, with a COPY of the production credentials and Chromium profile; every cell is a real HTTP request against a real upstream.
source_commit_note: The run shipped the working tree that was committed as this hash; the two preceding commits on the branch are ad7beb3..3d4e1fe, with a0f4604d41aadcf118631d34809c3e33603d7f8a carrying the consumer-expiry half.
source_digest_method: sha256 over sorted <relpath>\u0000<committed blob bytes>\u0000 for src/m365_copilot_openai_proxy/**/*.py at the commit above, so the digest is reproducible from git alone.

failure_analysis_item_6c.verdict: environment blocker, not a regression from this cycle
failure_analysis_item_6c.cause: the consumer account's configured outbound proxy http://187.188.171.231:10101 was unreachable for the socket dial
evidence: TCP connect to 187.188.171.231:10101 timed out both from the deployment host and from inside the temp container (TimeoutError).

The same account's browser fallback refused to start for the same reason: 'the configured outbound proxy 187.188.171.231:10101 is unreachable (TimeoutError), so Camoufox would fail its own geoip lookup before the browser starts'.
The first RT exchange of the run failed with a transport-level 'HTTP error: ' (empty status), and Camoufox's geoip probe raised ProxyError(ConnectTimeoutError) against the same host.

The proxy is intermittent rather than dead: a Camoufox renewal succeeded once mid-run (token + 39 cookies in 20.6s), and the same cell retried three times afterwards answered 3/3 with real content and finish_reason=stop (94.8s / 90.0s / 11.0s, upstream_error=false).
failure_analysis_item_6c.production_baseline: Production's own logs show the same proxy failing the same preflight at 21:42 and 22:13 (proxy unreachable), so the blocker predates and is independent of the tree under acceptance.

environment_findings: Tone Claude_Sonnet (model id claude-sonnet-4-6) was refused upstream with result InternalError on 2/2 attempts at run time (400, 'M365 Copilot refused this turn instead of answering'), while m365-copilot, Magic and grok-4.5 answered 200. The tool cells therefore ran on Magic; the router/studio planning cells prove the tool path on a tone upstream accepts today.

The production keys.json holds three enabled keys bound to accounts that no longer exist in accounts.json (acct_c629208b8b44, acct_e1c02959bef5, acct_0762a35afa63). They cannot serve a turn; the probe now skips account-less keys.
